title: Expanding Cardano's Reach in Africa: New Hubs Outreach & Onboarding

ms.promise:
One market research report - Investigating strategic locations within Africa to onboard new hubs.
The report will include:
・The current technological landscape, and detailed research methodology. 
・Analysis on specific regions like Kenya, South Africa and Nigeria, considering proximity to universities, technology centers and business districts. 
・Data sources such as research papers and industry reports in addition to primary data collection methods like surveys and interviews will be used with an emphasis on open-source availability. 

The findings will provide strategic recommendations that aligns with Wada's mission and offering actionable insights for establishing and sustaining hubs. The report will be publicly shared through various channels.
ms.criteria:
Report to include:
・Target demographics.
・Economic indicators.
・Forecasts and analysis.
・At least 3 countries identified as high potential for outreach and onboarding.

In addition:
・Demographic analysis including population size, age distribution, education levels and employment sectors.
・Detailed economic analysis covering GDP, growth rates, investment climate, technological adoption and industry sectors.
・Projections of technological and economic trends, potential for hub success and strategic recommendations.

・Recruitment and identification of an appropriate hub manager for the relevant location.
・Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding with the prospective hub manager in order to proceed with discussions for partnership and hub set up.

・A set of agreements for outreach by the hub to local business and organizations to promote Cardano and the hub as an onboarding point for the local Cardano community.
・Established partnership with a local stakeholder such as government, educational institution, technology company or other relevant party.
